title: Notifications
description: Security alerts, account changes and new apps.

LOGIN_ANOMALY.title: New sign-in to your account
LOGIN_ANOMALY.body: {reason, select, country {A sign-in from {country}, where you haven't signed in before.} both {{browser} on {os}, from {country} — a device and a country we haven't seen before.} other {{browser} on {os} — a device we haven't seen on your account before.}}

ACCOUNT_LOCKED.title: Account temporarily locked
ACCOUNT_LOCKED.body: Too many wrong passwords. Sign-in was blocked for {minutes} minutes.

PASSWORD_CHANGED.title: {actor, select, admin {Your password was reset by an administrator} other {Your password was changed}}
PASSWORD_CHANGED.body: {actor, select, admin {Sign in with the temporary password from your email, then choose a new one.} other {If this wasn't you, reset your password right away.}}

ENTITLEMENT_REVOKED.title: Access removed
ENTITLEMENT_REVOKED.body: You no longer have access to {appName}.

SYSTEM_ANNOUNCEMENT.title: Announcement
SYSTEM_ANNOUNCEMENT.body: There is a new announcement from Ducker ID.
